name: ECONOVA
tagline: All-in-one R290 heat pump hot water with Wi-Fi and inverter control.
summary: The ECONOVA residential range is a round-tank, all-in-one heat pump hot water system. It draws heat from the air using R290, a natural refrigerant, and an inverter DC compressor with variable frequency control.
Every model is Wi-Fi enabled with a timer, and most add a rapid boost element for back-up.

image.alt: ECONOVA dark grey all-in-one heat pump

highlights.title: R290 refrigerant
highlights.text: Uses R290, an ozone-friendly natural refrigerant, to absorb heat from the air.

highlights.title: Inverter compressor
highlights.text: A high efficiency DC compressor with variable frequency electric control.

highlights.title: Wi-Fi and timer
highlights.text: All models are Wi-Fi enabled and work with a mobile app and timer.

highlights.title: Wide operating range
highlights.text: Operates in ambient temperatures from -7 to +40 degrees Celsius.

highlights.title: Auto disinfection
highlights.text: Periodically heats the water above its set temperature to prevent bacteria and legionella.

highlights.title: Low operating noise
highlights.text: Engineered to operate with low noise levels.
